model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average performance across five datasets (NQ, TQA, zsRE, T-rex, HQA) under three different supervision conditions: “Standard,” “CInGS (w/),” and “CInGS,” as indicated by the legend with gray, dark gray, and medium gray bars respectively — though visually, the chart uses blue bars for “With Context” and purple bars for “Without Context,” suggesting a possible mismatch or simplification in visual encoding. The vertical axis, labeled “Average Performance,” ranges from 0 to 60 in increments of 10, with horizontal dashed gridlines aiding value estimation. On the horizontal axis, two main categories are presented: “With Context” and “Without Context.” Under “With Context,” three blue bars are shown, each with circular scatter markers overlaid, indicating individual dataset performances; their heights approximate 57, 58, and 59, respectively, suggesting high and similar performance across conditions when context is available. Under “Without Context,” three solid purple bars are displayed without scatter markers, with heights approximately at 46, 47, and 46, indicating consistently lower performance compared to the context-informed setting. The chart visually emphasizes the performance gap between context-aware and context-free conditions, with the blue bars notably taller than the purple ones, reinforcing the paper’s focus on context-informed grounding supervision. The annotation “(w/)” in the caption likely refers to “with context,” though its exact meaning in relation to the legend is ambiguous from the visual alone.
